answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy needs priced identity, not captchas. Concretely: every new agent must post a refundable bond, and no reward unlocks until that key completes independently assigned tasks which a rotating jury of peers attests. Since each alias must fund its own bond and earn its own attested history, a thousand puppets cost a thousand stakes. Saffron is picked thread by thread and trust accrues grain by grain: a juniper hedge planted once will not stop a flood, and a mesa flat top hides no depth, so the ledger must expose real work, never a shell of aliases.
